title: Trace Evolution Bench: Measuring Whether Agents Improve from Their Own Environment Traces
abstract: arXiv:2610.15055v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Self-evolving agents are usually scored by endpoint Gain: held-out success after an update minus success before. That difference can credit a frozen rescore as evolution. We introduce Trace Evolution Bench (TEB), a protocol that separates that rescore from a context or weight update, together with three frozen 80/20/40 packs. An update is accepted only when validation does not fall, held-out identifiers never enter the update, and a text update is not ranked with a weight update. The primary scoreboard is coding, graded by hidden unit tests in a closed workspace. On that pack (40 held-out tasks, one family), DeepSeek v4 Pro under no_evolve never changes its policy yet moves 7.5, 5.0, and 12.5 percentage points across three seeds. Of nine text-update cells inspired by GEPA, ACE, and ExpeL, seven have positive excess above that seed's own band, and one gepa_llm seed moves down by the width of its band (-12.5, regression 0.48). GLM and Mini

translated_title: 轨迹演化基准：衡量智能体是否从自身环境轨迹中获得改进
translated_abstract: 自进化智能体通常通过端点增益来评分，即更新后在保留集上的成功率减去更新前的成功率。这种差异可能会把冻结的重新评分误判为进化。我们提出轨迹演化基准（TEB），这是一个将重新评分与上下文或权重更新相分离的协议，并配有三个冻结的 80/20/40 数据包。只有在验证集性能不下降、保留集标识符绝不进入更新过程、且文本更新不与权重更新一起排名时，更新才被接受。主要计分板为编程任务，通过封闭工作区中的隐藏单元测试进行评分。在该数据包（40 个保留任务、单一任务族）上，DeepSeek v4 Pro 在 no_evolve 条件下从不改变其策略，却在三个随机种子上分别波动了 7.5、5.0 和 12.5 个百分点。在受 GEPA、ACE 和 ExpeL 启发的九个文本更新单元格中，七个的超出量高于该种子自身的波动带，而一个 gepa_llm 种子向下移动了其波动带的宽度（-12.5，回归值 0.48）。GLM 和 Mini
tldr: 提出轨迹演化基准（TEB），通过将冻结重新评分与真正的上下文或权重更新相分离，并要求验证集不下降、保留集无泄漏，来严格检验自进化智能体是否真正从自身环境轨迹中获得改进。
en_tdlr: Trace Evolution Bench (TEB) is a protocol that disentangles frozen re-scoring noise from genuine context or weight updates, rigorously measuring whether self-evolving agents truly improve from their own environment traces.
